description: Homepage-only 'Rollups in action' scroll-synced sidebar showcase: an IntersectionObserver picks the viewport-centered card as 'current' and updates a sidebar nav.

motion.scrollSync: IntersectionObserver selects the card whose center is nearest viewport center as 'current'
motion.reducedMotionFallback: renders the first card as current with no scroll-driven re-selection; all cards remain statically visible
